entries.justification: public static API contract; MCP clients already receive route-shaped tools from the authenticated tool list
public edition posture endpoint; the AI tool catalog should not expose license posture as a tenant action
MCP catalog endpoint; adding a REST-backed MCP tool for it would recursively list the tool list
MCP invocation endpoint; adding a REST-backed MCP tool for it would allow recursive tool calls

public presentation-only endpoint; the brand tells a browser how to render the login screen and carries no tenant data, so exposing it as an AI tool action would add a tool that can only answer what the page already shows

provider webhook receiver: only GitHub, holding the hook's signing secret, can call it (X-Hub-Signature-256); an AI tool could neither sign a delivery nor need to, since scans are queued through the authenticated repository scan routes
